name: Improved Logger
description: An interactive console for the logs: groups by mod, folds repeats, search, level and mod filters

general-title.name: General
general-title.description: Changes only the <cb>platform console</c> (turn on <cy>Show Platform Console</c> in Geode's settings). Log files stay exactly as Geode writes them

enabled.name: Grouped console
enabled.description: Off gives the console back to Geode's usual output

mode.name: Console mode
mode.description: Interactive: the console becomes a screen to browse the logs with the keyboard and mouse, fold groups, search, filter by level and mod, read a log in full and copy it. Press <cy>?</c> in the console for all keys. Stream: lines are printed as they come, like Geode does

group-by-mod.name: Group by mod
group-by-mod.description: Logs that come one after another from the same mod go under one header with the mod's name, instead of repeating it on every line

mod-colors.name: Mod colors
mod-colors.description: Each mod gets its own color for its header and the line on the left of its logs

nest-guides.name: Nesting guides
nest-guides.description: Logs written inside <cy>log::NestScope</c> (or between <cy>log::pushNest</c> and <cy>log::popNest</c>) get vertical guides, like a tree

gap.name: Pause gap
gap.description: After this many seconds without logs, the next ones start a new block after an empty line, so bursts (a click, a level load) stand apart. 0 turns it off

marker-key.name: Marker key
marker-key.description: Puts a marker line into the logs from the game, to see what got logged after you did something. <cy>b</c> does the same in the console

collapse.name: Fold repeats
collapse.description: Identical: the same line written again and again stays one line with a counter. Similar: lines that differ only in numbers fold too (a position every frame, a progress "3/10"), the line shows the latest values

filter-title.name: Filter
filter-title.description: Mods are written by ID or by name, separated by commas, for example <cy>geode.loader, Icon Mayhem</c>

focus-mods.name: Focus on mods
focus-mods.description: Only these mods show all their logs, the others show just warnings and errors. Empty shows everyone
